conservation-law-noether-current-606a86e.title: Noether Current Local Conservation
conservation-law-noether-current-606a86e.interpretation: Defines the local conservation of the Noether current density $J^\mu$, asserting that the four-divergence of the current density vanishes identically across all spacetime points to prevent non-local instantaneous transport of physical quantities.
conservation-law-noether-current-606a86e.symmetry_origin: Derived from Noether's first theorem, establishing a one-to-one correspondence between every differentiable continuous global symmetry of the action integral and a local field conservation law.
conservation-law-noether-current-606a86e.limits_and_boundary: Under spatial boundaries where the field configurations decay sufficiently rapidly at infinity, the spatial integral of the time component $J^0$ yields a globally conserved Noether charge $Q$, which remains strictly constant in coordinate time.
